title: Rosalind and the Colony
author: Lior Ishikawa
blurb: Lior Quintana, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, has spent fifteen years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
